title: A Mexican Artist Sang Some of His Hits. Authorities Stopped the Show, Then Arrested Him.
summary_full: A concert by the singer Gabito Ballesteros was suspended after he sang songs that supposedly glorify cartel culture. The action has renewed a debate over culture and free speech.
